grammar.title: Only if... then with 只有...才
grammar.pattern: 只有 + 条件，(主语) + 才 + 结果
grammar.explanation: 只有 (zhǐyǒu) states the one necessary condition for something to happen, and 才 (cái) in the result clause means "only then". Together they say a result can happen in no other way except through this one condition — a stronger, more exclusive version of 如果...就.

grammar.title: Always with 总是
grammar.pattern: (主语) + 总是 + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 总是 (zǒngshì) means "always" — describing something that happens every time, without exception. It goes right before the verb, similar to 老是 but more neutral in tone.

sentences.zh: 由于工作太忙，他没有时间休息。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú gōngzuò tài máng, tā méiyǒu shíjiān xiūxi.
sentences.en: Due to being too busy with work, he has no time to rest.

sentences.zh: 由于身体不好，她请假了。
sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú shēntǐ bù hǎo, tā qǐngjià le.
sentences.en: Due to poor health, she took leave.

sentences.zh: 面对这个问题，我们要好好想想。
sentences.pinyin: Miànduì zhège wèntí, wǒmen yào hǎohāo xiǎngxiang.
sentences.en: Facing this problem, we need to think it over carefully.
